title: RISE Research Institutes of Sweden
content:
RISE Research Institutes of Sweden is Sweden's state research institute and innovation partner and one of Europe's largest research institutes, operating around one hundred testbeds and demonstration facilities across the country.

Its materials divisions cover polymer and composite technology, building physics, fire technology and energy efficiency, providing testing and certification services aligned with European standards for construction products.

For the aerogel sector, RISE offers characterization of thermal insulation performance, fire behaviour and moisture durability of novel insulation products, and participates in collaborative R&D projects on advanced porous materials together with industry and academia.
excerpt: Sweden's national research institute offering testing and R&D services for insulation performance, fire safety and durability relevant to aerogel materials.
